# Lifehacker

> Lifehacker is a practical tech and lifestyle guide dedicated to helping readers do everything better through tips, tricks, hacks, and product recommendations.

Lifehacker covers a broad range of topics including technology news, product reviews, smart home devices, productivity hacks, health and fitness, entertainment, and home improvement. The site features expert guides, buyer comparisons, and curated deals on consumer electronics and gadgets.

## Key Topics

- Tech News
- Product Reviews
- Smart Home Devices
- Smartphones
- AI Tools
- VPNs & Privacy
- Gaming
- Wearable Tech
- How-To Guides
- Tech Deals
- Amazon Devices
- Apple Products
- Fitness Trackers
- Hardware Reviews
- Software Tutorials

## Core Hubs

- [Lifehacker Homepage](https://lifehacker.com): Main hub featuring top stories, tech news, deals, and latest articles
- [Latest News & Articles](https://lifehacker.com/latest): Latest news and advice covering tech, cooking, personal finance, and trending hacks
- [Tech Hub](https://lifehacker.com/tech): Tech news, reviews, and advice on smartphones, computers, and smart devices
- [Newsletters](https://lifehacker.com/newsletters): Subscribe to daily tips, tech news, deals, and smart home content

## Product Guides & Reviews

- [Best Picks](https://lifehacker.com/best-picks): Curated best picks and buyer guides for tech hardware, gaming, and consumer products
- [Product Reviews](https://lifehacker.com/reviews): In-depth reviews of tech gadgets, wearables, smartphones, earbuds, and fitness tech
- [Product Comparisons](https://lifehacker.com/comparisons): Side-by-side comparisons for smart glasses, VR headsets, fitness trackers, and smartwatches
- [TV Reviews & Deals](https://lifehacker.com/tech/tvs): TV reviews and deals covering OLED, Samsung, Sony, Hisense, and 65-inch models

## Technology Guides

- [AI Tools & Guides](https://lifehacker.com/tech/ai): AI tips, tools, and how-to guides for Google Workspace, NotebookLM, and productivity
- [Hardware Guides](https://lifehacker.com/tech/hardware): Hardware guides and reviews for gaming, routers, laptops, and device hacks
- [Software Tips & Tutorials](https://lifehacker.com/tech/software): Software tips and tutorials for productivity, Chrome, Word, VPNs, and tech tools
- [Mobile Apps Guide](https://lifehacker.com/tech/mobile-apps): Mobile app guides for Signal, WhatsApp, Bluesky, messaging, and social media apps
- [How-To & Hacks](https://lifehacker.com/hacks): How-to articles and guides for tech tutorials, productivity, and device hacks

## Privacy & Security

- [Privacy Guides](https://lifehacker.com/tech/privacy): Privacy guides covering data protection, tracking, breaches, and surveillance
- [Best Paid VPNs](https://lifehacker.com/tech/the-best-paid-vpns): In-depth VPN comparison and review guide including Mullvad VPN and other top services
- [Accessing Blocked Content](https://lifehacker.com/tech/how-to-watch-pornhub-even-if-its-blocked-in-your-state): VPN guide for accessing content blocked by state regulations and age verification

## Lifestyle & Entertainment

- [Entertainment Hub](https://lifehacker.com/entertainment): TV recommendations, movies, gaming, and pop culture content
- [Health & Fitness](https://lifehacker.com/health): Fitness advice, wearables, trackers, and sports recovery tips
- [Home & Garden](https://lifehacker.com/home): Home and garden advice on organizing, decluttering, gardening, and DIY improvements

## Deals & Discounts

- [Tech Deals](https://lifehacker.com/deals): Tech deals and discounts on Amazon devices, smart home, phones, and gadgets
